video_title: Taj Gibson joins Don, Hahn & Rosenberg

quotes.speaker: Taj Gibson
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's leadership and impact on the Knicks' culture
quotes.excerpt: they got a proven point guard who wants to win. And it showed how selfless can he be
quotes.quote: I knew they got a proven point guard who wants to win. And it showed how selfless can he be, just taking a pay cut, making sure everybody is coming to town, making sure he takes good care of his teammates off the court. He is phenomenal. I was just in awe of watching him grow up and then to become a pro, be a great teammate, just be a leader, and then to kill the way he killed in the playoffs, I am not surprised because he puts the work in.

quotes.speaker: Taj Gibson
quotes.summary_phrase: Taj Gibson's commitment to staying in shape and playing professionally
quotes.excerpt: I am always in shape. I am 240, I am in shape right now
quotes.quote: I am always in shape. I am 240, I am in shape right now. It is just a part of my regimen. I am a professional, so when I see the young players, the young guys that are coming in the league, I have to look the part so when I do say something, I have to be held accountable. So that is just a part of my life. I am a professional, that is all I know, really.

quotes.speaker: Taj Gibson
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns' growth and maturity as a leader
quotes.excerpt: I remember being in Minnesota with a young Karl-Anthony Towns and all he was trying to do
quotes.quote: I remember being in Minnesota with a young Karl-Anthony Towns and all he was trying to do was just show the world how good he was and how much of a scorer he can be and lead a team. And over the years I always listened to the conversations we had, how mature he got and how much he really wanted to take that next step. And when we played in New York, when I was in Memphis later in the season, he was banged up, he was going through all the nonsense, I was hearing the rumbles. He came down to the visiting locker room and waited for me. He said I didn't get a chance to see you. I had to come see you. The way he was responding to my conversation after I was asking him is he okay, like everything is good, he said don't worry about it, it is a part of the process. I have to be ready and I am ready for it. And I was just like, man, that is the kind of guy you want to play with. He gets it.
